_comment: Every video tutorial, keyed by the id a page names in its `video` front matter. lib/videos.mjs derives the player, key moments, transcript, VideoObject markup and video sitemap entry from this and the two WebVTT tracks, so nothing is written twice. The duration is the end of the last chapter, in whole seconds.

swift-interop.name: Osprey and Swift interop: Mac and iPhone app tutorial
swift-interop.description: A three-minute video tutorial. Osprey exports compile to a C header that Swift calls, Swift @_cdecl functions become Osprey imports, and one Xcode target ships the same app to the Mac and the iPhone.
swift-interop.posterAlt: Osprey + Swift title card with the Osprey bird, the Osprey Storage app icon and the words One app, Mac and iPhone

profiler.name: Profiling Osprey in VS Code: CPU, memory and leaks
profiler.description: A two-minute video tutorial. Run and profile the open file, read the flame graph and the heat on your source, attach to a program that is already running, then see how Osprey's memory backends work and check a program for leaks with ARC.
profiler.posterAlt: The Profiling Osprey title card with the Osprey bird and the words CPU, memory, leaks, in VS Code

package-manager.name: Add and remove Osprey packages in VS Code
package-manager.description: Browse Osprey packages, review audit warnings, add and verify a dependency, then remove it through the VS Code package workspace.
package-manager.posterAlt: The VS Code Command Palette with Osprey: Manage Packages selected.
